title: Period pain
claims: Period pain usually lasts for up to 3 days and can affect daily activities.
Self-care suggestions include a warm bath or shower, a heat pad, gentle exercise such as yoga, swimming, walking or cycling, and massage.
The page advises an urgent GP appointment or NHS 111 if pelvic or period pain is severe or worse than usual and painkillers have not helped.
The page advises seeing a GP if period pain stops usual daily activities, or if periods become more painful, heavier or irregular.
Bleeding between periods is listed as a reason to see a GP.
